summaryForNext: Zero of five goals met. Key gaps: hosted no-login collides with a daemon that has no per-user identity (R1); upstream cloud (Vela/AMR/collab/telemetry) is entangled through server.ts but bounded, with no payment code in-repo; fabric lacks object storage and billing; UAR is HTTP-only and undeployed so needs an ACP stdio wrapper; rebrand touches ~3,200 files with identity-breaking decisions. Six operator decisions needed before analyze/plan (hosting model, keep/drop list, upstream strategy, rename depth, brand token source, UAR deployment). Adversarial review not run (model preflight stale since 2026-09-14).
